instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium side-profile shot from a low angle. In a sunny park with a palm tree trunk on the left, the man in the maroon polo shirt (R1) carries the young girl in the pink tie-dye dress (R2) on his shoulders. Both are shown in profile; the man (R1) looks forward while the young girl (R2) looks down at him with a joyful smile, her hand resting on his head. Bright daylight casts soft shadows against a clear blue sky.
